study_identification_part.si_4_title: Heterogeneity of morphometric similarity networks in health and schizophrenia

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Bayesian linear regression (BLR) with likelihood warping using a B-spline (spline order = 3, number of knots = 5) was used. The implementation follows the PCNtoolkit framework for normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Bayesian linear regression (BLR) with likelihood warping using a B-spline (spline order = 3, number of knots = 5) was used to predict morphometric similarity from a vector of covariates (age, sex, Euler number, and scanner)
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional morphometric similarity was the response variable. Morphometric similarity was calculated from five MRI-derived features: (1) cortical thickness, (2) surface area, (3) cortical volume, (4) mean curvature, and (5) Gaussian curvature, for each of the 62 regions of the DKT atlas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Using regional measurements of cortical thickness, surface area, cortical volume, mean curvature, and Gaussian curvature, we calculated regional morphometric similarity following a previously published protocol
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Morphometric similarity

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Four covariates were used in the normative model: age (linear term), sex, Euler number (as a proxy for image quality), and scanner. The Euler number was included to reduce residual variance due to differences in image quality across subjects.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Bayesian linear regression (BLR) with likelihood warping using a B-spline (spline order = 3, number of knots = 5) was used to predict morphometric similarity from a vector of covariates (age, sex, Euler number, and scanner). In order to reduce residual variance due to differences in image quality across subjects, we decided to include the Euler number as a variable in our normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity
